summary: 107 unit tests (579 assertions, 3 vendor deprecations) pass in 2s and cover PO-reference, badge, theme and demo-account logic well, but no coverage driver exists locally or in CI so coverage is unmeasured (estimated ~45-55 % of non-entity code). Smoke tests (~47) are fixture-coupled and CI lacks coverage and schema validation.

metrics.coverage: estimation ~45-55 % (no pcov/xdebug available; crossing 27 non-entity src classes with tests: ~14 exercised, ~13 logic classes with no test; 80+ entities/Sylius overrides excluded)

findings.title: Coverage never measured (no driver locally, coverage: none in CI)
findings.detail: php -m shows neither pcov nor xdebug; setup-php uses 'coverage: none' and no job runs --coverage-*. The 80 % target of the project rules cannot be verified. Estimate only.
findings.recommendation: Add pcov to the dev image and a CI step 'phpunit --coverage-clover' with a threshold on src/Demo, src/PunchOut, src/Invoice, src/Order (exclude src/Entity).

findings.title: Logic classes with no test at all
findings.detail: No test references: ChannelSwitchController, ConsumerChannelVoter, DemoChannelContext, BadgeToggleController, HealthController, LegalPagesController (indirect smoke only), PluginsController, DemoTwigExtension, BadgeTwigExtension, PackagingUnitProvider/DoctrinePackagingUnitRows (partly via B2bThemeTest fakes), OrderPoReferenceTypeExtension (form constraints), and the 11 DataFixtures in src/Demo/DataFixtures (only indirectly through smoke). The channel voter and context carry B2B/B2C access rules.
findings.recommendation: Unit-test DemoChannelContext and ConsumerChannelVoter (cookie/user -> channel decision) and add a form test for OrderPoReferenceTypeExtension (max length, required-per-channel).

findings.title: Configuration-only tests (hooks declared, never rendered)
findings.detail: ThemeHooksTest parses config/packages/demo_theme_b2b.yaml and asserts hookable names/keys: it proves hooks are declared, not rendered (the sprint 3-4 lesson). PluginBadgesSmokeTest / PluginDataCoherenceSmokeTest likewise assert seeded rows/config. B2bThemeTest and PoReferenceTemplatesTest do render Twig and are good.
findings.recommendation: Add one rendering smoke per theme hook (GET product list/page, assert b2b_* hookable markup) so a declared-but-unrendered hook fails; keep ThemeHooksTest as a guard only.

findings.title: Smoke tests are non-hermetic and assert hard-coded fixture data
findings.detail: Smoke tests require 'sylius:fixtures:load --suite=demo' (headers of AccountsSmokeTest, CatalogSmokeTest, PunchOutOrderRequestSmokeTest, PluginDataCoherenceSmokeTest) and hard-code emails (claire@acme.example), limits (50_000), counts (testFiveCompaniesExist). No transaction rollback/DAMA; tests are read-only so no pollution, but any fixture edit breaks them. phpunit.xml.dist has a single testsuite, so plain 'vendor/bin/phpunit' fails without a DB.
findings.recommendation: Split phpunit.xml.dist into Unit and Smoke suites; derive expectations from DemoAccountCatalog instead of literals; use dama/doctrine-test-bundle if write tests are added.

findings.title: Mixed @dataProvider docblock vs #[DataProvider] attribute
findings.detail: PagesTest.php:69 and :93 use '/** @dataProvider */' annotations, deprecated in PHPUnit 10 and removed in 12 (project rules target PHPUnit 12; composer pins ^10.5.66). All other files use attributes.
findings.recommendation: Convert the two annotations to #[DataProvider]; consider upgrading to PHPUnit 12.

findings.title: 3 vendor deprecations during the unit run
findings.detail: Liip\ImagineBundle FilterExtension and FilterTrait (deprecated 2.7, set liip_imagine.twig.mode=lazy) triggered by DemoAccountsTest; sylius.routing.loader.resource (sylius/resource-bundle 1.13) triggered by DemoPluginRoutesTest:14. All originate in vendor/config, none in src/.
findings.recommendation: Set liip_imagine.twig.mode: lazy in config/packages; track the Sylius resource deprecation upstream.

findings.title: CI gaps: no doctrine:schema:validate, --no-scripts, PHP 8.4 vs 8.5, no coverage
findings.detail: CI runs ecs, phpstan, lint:container, migrations, fixtures load, then one vendor/bin/phpunit (Unit + Smoke). Missing: doctrine:schema:validate (mapping/migration drift undetected), coverage. 'composer install --no-scripts' skips cache warmup/assets (documented workaround). setup-php uses 8.4 while dev/runtime is PHP 8.5, so 8.5 deprecations are not caught. Unit tests are not a separate fast job.
findings.recommendation: Add 'doctrine:schema:validate' after migrate, a PHP 8.4/8.5 matrix, a separate Unit step before DB setup, and coverage output.

findings.title: Domain unit tests present and behavioural
findings.detail: Pyramid: 107 Unit (~70 %, 5 classes Kernel-based rendering/container tests) vs ~47 Smoke methods (~30 %: ~38 kernel/DB-level, ~9 HTTP in PagesTest/LegalPagesTest/PluginsAndHomepageTest/AccountsSmokeTest). PO reference, CII XML writer, PunchOut subscriber/blocker, badges, CSV reader, reset command and theme providers have solid tests including edge/error cases (corrupted value escaping, blank packaging). Suite runs in 2.2 s.
findings.recommendation: Keep; add equivalent tests for the untested classes listed above.

findings.title: Gherkin scenarios without matching test (sample of 4 stories)
findings.detail: US-015 (7 scenarios): covered = accounts list and false-mention fix (DemoAccountsTest), disabled account (AccountsSmokeTest:168); missing = one-click login actually authenticating, login pages on shop/admin showing accounts, 'production without demo mode'. US-021 (6): OrderPoReferenceTest covers length/char validation; no functional checkout test for required-per-channel, cost-center-only, optional channel. US-022 (5): PoReferenceTemplatesTest, CII writer, PunchOut subscriber cover admin/email/XML/corruption; missing = Factur-X bridge unavailable degradation, shop order page. US-013 (6): B2bThemeTest covers card, from-price, no packaging; missing = anonymous visitor on B2B channel, B2C channel not themed, theme asset unavailable (only config-level ThemeHooksTest).
findings.recommendation: Add WebTestCase scenarios for one-click login, B2C vs B2B rendering and checkout PO validation; tag tests with #[Group('US-021')] for traceability.
